title: Production requirements: Apex 7 parity, modern improvements, and architectural authoring

task_plan.description: The requirements and scope approved in the project conversation.

qt_licensing.description: Qt licensing reference; exact shipped modules remain to be qualified.

planegcs_source.description: PlaneGCS constraint API reference; application qualification remains required.

requirements.requirement: Drawing, editing, calculating, saving, recovering, printing, and exporting work with networking disabled.
requirements.acceptance: On a clean Windows machine with network adapters disabled, complete the full authoring and output workflow without a network error or account prompt.
requirements.implementation_note: Offline policy declarations and fail-closed diagnostics are implemented; network-disabled end-to-end clean-machine workflow evidence remains open.

requirements.requirement: The application has no account, activation server, subscription, or online entitlement dependency.
requirements.acceptance: Static dependency review and a network-denied run show no entitlement check, sign-in requirement, or remote service needed for the required workflows.
requirements.implementation_note: The startup policy rejects unknown/required account, activation, subscription, and network dependencies; static dependency and runtime network-denial qualification remain open.

requirements.requirement: Installation is offline-capable and bundles required runtime components, fonts, help, libraries, resources, and optional local-assistance assets.
requirements.acceptance: Install from the offline installer and portable package on a clean machine with networking disabled, then open bundled help and complete a project workflow.
requirements.implementation_note: Runtime independence policy and portable staging are implemented; the portable package now carries a local user guide and PROJ resources, and a task-owned install plus installed-runtime smoke pass on the development host. Installer creation and clean-machine offline qualification remain open.

requirements.requirement: Deliver the original application source privately with reproducible Windows build instructions, fixtures, and build configuration.
requirements.acceptance: The delivered source archive builds the shipped artifacts on a documented Windows environment from a clean checkout without a hosted build service.
requirements.implementation_note: Dependency inventory and a deterministic allowlisted source-kit manifest are implemented; complete private handoff, clean-checkout rebuild, licensing/SBOM review, and production gate remain open.

requirements.requirement: Provide a documented, versioned .bldproj project format whose geometry, classifications, assets, metadata, history, and migrations are inspectable locally.
requirements.acceptance: Format documentation and the CLI describe schema versions, required fields, asset references, migration behavior, and preservation rules; a fixture round-trips through the documented format.
requirements.implementation_note: A broker-backed ProjectOwnershipSession reserves normalized paths and existing file identities, detects external content changes, and is integrated into desktop open/save/Save As. Unit, cross-process, and desktop workflow fixtures cover contention, Windows path casing, external edits, read-only second opens, and a durable Document latch through navigation and validated forks. Clean-machine lifetime, restart recovery, hostile writer races, and full production acceptance remain open.

requirements.requirement: The production application targets Windows 11 x64, supports imperial and metric units, and serves residential and light-commercial projects.
requirements.acceptance: Supported OS, unit profiles, and representative residential and light-commercial fixtures are listed and pass the final acceptance workflow.
requirements.implementation_note: Windows 11 x64, both unit systems, both target markets, both workspaces, and offline ownership are represented by a strict scope contract; representative production fixtures and final acceptance remain open.

requirements.requirement: Measurement and Architectural are separate workspaces over one shared project and authoritative document model.
requirements.acceptance: A project created in Measurement can be opened in Architectural, and edits, calculations, links, and saved revisions remain consistent in both workspaces.
requirements.implementation_note: The desktop shell exposes pan, zoom, grid, and independent output controls; the primary toolbar is a fixed 20 px logical row with 14 px icons and no redundant header band. Interactive plan canvases now render a model-space overview map with viewport framing and click-to-recenter navigation; asynchronous navigation evidence and the complete acceptance statement remain open.

requirements.requirement: One semantic document model is authoritative for property/site, buildings, storeys, levels, layers, objects, boundaries, annotations, schedules, sheets, phases, and alternatives.
requirements.acceptance: Plans, calculations, projections, schedules, exports, and printing consume the same document revision and stable entity IDs.
requirements.implementation_note: The Document NameRevision command is now surfaced in a local desktop editor with ordered listing, read-only entity/asset comparison, and guarded restore-as-new-project copies that preserve the open document. Geometric/calculation/presentation diff detail and production fixtures remain open.

requirements.requirement: Typed links distinguish architectural walls, room boundaries, and appraisal measurement boundaries, with explicit ownership and no unconstrained bidirectional cycles.
requirements.acceptance: Independent, wall-derived, and measurement-driven relationships can be created, frozen, disconnected, undone, and rejected when cyclic or ambiguous.
requirements.implementation_note: Immutable typed relationship validation and deterministic serialization are implemented. A detached proposal engine validates rigid rotation/translation propagation, target-first dependency chains, and multi-driver agreement without mutating snapshots; a revision-bound Document preview/apply adapter preserves stable identities, dependent dimension anchors, and construction receipts through a strict transform proof. The Windows editor provides a visible canvas preview and confirmation step; production qualification remains open.

requirements.requirement: Save serializes an immutable snapshot at revision R into a validated standalone project while preserving the prior destination file.
requirements.acceptance: Interleaved edits during save produce a file containing exactly the reported saved revision; a failed replacement leaves the previous valid file recoverable.
requirements.implementation_note: Partial implementation exists; the complete acceptance statement and production gate remain open.

requirements.requirement: Every authoritative output carries an OutputFingerprint for document revision, profiles, assets, fonts, views, and processing components.
requirements.acceptance: Changing a fingerprint input either regenerates output or produces a visible stale-output block; matching inputs reproduce the same output identity.
requirements.implementation_note: Core digest/manifest/currentness checks are implemented and tested. PDF, SVG, and native 3D image exports now emit adjacent fingerprint manifests, and print preview writes a local driver-evidence receipt; stale-output blocking, reproducibility fixtures, physical calibration, and production acceptance remain open. Serialized identity excludes private entity and asset payloads.

requirements.requirement: All edits use typed serialized commands over immutable snapshots; accepted compound operations commit atomically and are reversible.
requirements.acceptance: A compound edit either commits as one revision with one undo entry or leaves the previous revision unchanged; stale worker results cannot overwrite newer edits.
requirements.implementation_note: Partial implementation exists; the complete acceptance statement and production gate remain open.

requirements.requirement: Entered quantities and units remain distinct from derived values, with analytical geometry, explicit tolerances, and display rounding that never changes measurement truth.
requirements.acceptance: Fixtures retain entered dimensions and calculate within the documented tolerance after display-format changes, save/reopen, and unit conversion.
requirements.implementation_note: Partial implementation exists; the complete acceptance statement and production gate remain open.

requirements.requirement: BRep geometry, meshes, projections, render pixels, and calculation caches are derived data and cannot become independent document authorities.
requirements.acceptance: Rebuilding or deleting derived caches leaves semantic geometry intact and all consumers regenerate from the document snapshot.
requirements.implementation_note: The bounded semantic slice is implemented: one validated slab geometry model carries an explicit slab/floor/ceiling/foundation kind; Windows authoring creates each kind from a closed boundary; Document admission, native solid decoding, plan/elevation/section/3D projection, material schedules, undo/redo, and save/reopen preserve it. Full floor-system materials, level coordination, quantity certification, Apex compatibility, and the production gate remain open.

requirements.requirement: Migrations are copy-based and reversible, preserve originals and unknown data, and block unsafe editing or authoritative output for unsupported required features.
requirements.acceptance: Each schema migration preserves the source fixture, reports unsupported content, and can be validated or rolled back without data loss.
requirements.implementation_note: Partial implementation exists; the complete acceptance statement and production gate remain open.

requirements.requirement: Provide a documented JSON-and-assets exchange representation plus local inspect, validate, extract, and migrate CLI operations.
requirements.acceptance: The CLI validates a good fixture, rejects malformed or incomplete data with actionable diagnostics, extracts assets, and produces a migration report.
requirements.implementation_note: Inspect, validate, extract, and copy based migrate commands now report local fingerprints and preserve the source; malformed/incomplete fixtures, broader migration reports, and production qualification remain open.

requirements.requirement: Apex exchange, CAD exchange, devices, georeferencing, and appraisal integrations attach through replaceable versioned adapters.
requirements.acceptance: A disabled or failed adapter does not prevent project open, deterministic editing, calculation, save, print, or export; manifests report protocol and capability versions.
requirements.implementation_note: Versioned descriptor and fail-closed registry are implemented and tested; concrete Apex/CAD/device/georeferencing/appraisal adapters and compatibility certification remain open.

requirements.requirement: Qualify exact source revisions, build options, transitive dependencies, and distribution obligations for every shipped component before release.
requirements.acceptance: A signed-off dependency inventory includes source hashes, SPDX licenses, notices, corresponding source or relink instructions, and an SBOM for each installer and portable package.
requirements.blocker: Exact revisions, transitive packages, and final build configuration must be selected and license-reviewed before distribution.
requirements.implementation_note: Partial implementation exists; the complete acceptance statement and production gate remain open.

requirements.requirement: Original application code remains clearly separated from third-party code, with contribution provenance suitable for later private sale or optional open source release.
requirements.acceptance: Repository provenance, contributor rights, notices, and third-party source locations are complete and reviewable without relying on a hosted service.
requirements.implementation_note: Partial implementation exists; the complete acceptance statement and production gate remain open.

requirements.requirement: The baseline excludes GPL/AGPL application dependencies, noncommercial restrictions, and mandatory paid runtime SDKs; applicable LGPL components meet their obligations.
requirements.acceptance: Automated and manual dependency review finds no prohibited baseline dependency and verifies the selected dynamic-linking and relink path.
requirements.implementation_note: Dependency inventory and notice checks are implemented; complete license review, dynamic-link/relink evidence, and production gate remain open.

requirements.requirement: Use a qualified Open CASCADE Technology layer for solid geometry, tessellation, and visualization with the original application model above it.
requirements.acceptance: Pinned OCCT builds render and regenerate representative residential and light-commercial solids, sections, and meshes without making render data authoritative.
requirements.implementation_note: Partial implementation exists; the complete acceptance statement and production gate remain open.

requirements.requirement: Use PlaneGCS/Eigen behind an application-owned planar constraint adapter; Ceres is not the planar solver substitute.
requirements.acceptance: The adapter reports degrees of freedom, redundancy, and conflict diagnostics for the application fixtures and contains no Ceres dependency for planar solving.
requirements.implementation_note: Partial implementation exists; the complete acceptance statement and production gate remain open.

requirements.requirement: Use isolated local workers for reviewed IFC and DXF parsing/export components, with adapter manifests and no dependency on a hosted service.
requirements.acceptance: Worker versions, formats, capabilities, resources, and failure behavior are recorded; worker failure leaves the core project usable.
requirements.implementation_note: Fail-closed IFC/DXF/PDF/PROJ worker declarations and attestations are implemented; deterministic native IFC and DXF project-mapping slices now have core and desktop transaction tests, while real worker binaries, broker/runtime enforcement, active worker isolation, and representative cross-application fixtures remain open.

requirements.requirement: Use reviewed Qt PDF and Print Support modules for vector output and printing, with an explicit module allowlist.
requirements.acceptance: The exact Qt module set builds offline, is license-audited, and produces the same vector scene used by preview and supported output formats.
requirements.implementation_note: The exact Qt PDF/PrintSupport allowlist is declared and validated; actual module audit, vector scene integration, and offline package qualification remain open.

requirements.requirement: Use PROJ with bundled local resources and networking disabled for georeferencing.
requirements.acceptance: Required coordinate operations complete from bundled resources while a network monitor confirms no download or remote callback.
requirements.implementation_note: The PROJ profile remains a fail-closed declaration, and the Windows runtime now verifies contained resource files and hashes, binds the local proj.db, disables context networking, validates CRS declarations, and exercises an identity operation. Full worker isolation and externally monitored operation fixtures remain open.

requirements.requirement: Represent lines, arcs, holes, winding, tangency, and topology as analytical geometry rather than screen strokes.
requirements.acceptance: Independent analytical and high-precision fixtures agree within the documented area and coordinate tolerances after save/reopen.
requirements.implementation_note: Partial implementation exists; the complete acceptance statement and production gate remain open.

requirements.requirement: Construct and edit true curves using chord length, arc length, arc height, and angle inputs.
requirements.acceptance: Each curve input mode produces the expected analytical arc, preserves its defining parameters, and edits without converting to a faceted stroke.
requirements.implementation_note: Analytical chord/angle, chord/height, chord/arc-length and start-tangent construction is tested; Windows now exposes interactive endpoint editing for angle, arc-length, and arc-height walls. Boundary curve authoring, joins, and complete parity qualification remain open.

requirements.requirement: Support rise-and-run entry, relative turns, explicit angles, and unit-aware direction input.
requirements.acceptance: Fixtures entered in imperial and metric units reproduce expected endpoints and headings with documented tolerance.
requirements.implementation_note: Rise/run, relative-turn, angle, and unit-aware entry are implemented and covered by focused fixtures; complete mapped imperial/metric heading tolerance evidence remains open.

requirements.requirement: Provide alignment, snapping, point jumping, automatic closure, and bay-window completion while retaining exact geometry.
requirements.acceptance: Keyboard and pointer fixtures show each behavior, expose the resulting constraint or closure, and reopen without drift.
requirements.implementation_note: Point jump, exact closure, bay completion, alignment/snap behavior and logical shortcut mappings have bounded geometry/UI foundations; physical shortcut verification, full command integration, and parity fixtures remain open.

requirements.requirement: Support editable parallel, perpendicular, horizontal, vertical, coincident, and fixed-length relationships.
requirements.acceptance: Constraint fixtures report intended degrees of freedom and preserve each relation through supported edits and save/reopen.
requirements.implementation_note: Seven persistent straight-wall endpoint relations now have add/edit/remove controls, source-bound solver previews and atomic Apply in both workspaces. V14 integrated tests pass Debug/Release; final hardening and independent service/UI review remain. Boundary vertex and curve relations remain open.

requirements.requirement: Preview dimension changes with an explicit anchored endpoint and an explicit choice about moving connected geometry.
requirements.acceptance: A 12-foot-to-14-foot edit previews both supported anchoring choices, shows dependent movement, and commits only after selection.
requirements.implementation_note: Both workspaces preview straight-wall length changes with start/end anchor and explicit connected-movement choice. Candidate and source digests bind Apply; keyboard, invalidation and comparison captures are covered. Boundary/curve editing and full production qualification remain open.

requirements.requirement: Detect redundant, contradictory, underconstrained, and near-singular constraint states with understandable diagnostics; never silently relax locked measurements.
requirements.acceptance: Conflict fixtures identify the offending relations, offer only explicit user-confirmed repairs, and leave the previous valid revision intact on rejection.
requirements.implementation_note: Independent document checks enforce locks and preserve unknown-history semantics read-only. Interactive previews expose solver conflicts; locked-length and frozen-neighbor failures leave state intact. Complete singularity/conflict-repair workflows remain open.

requirements.requirement: Prevent unintended mirrored solutions, winding changes, topology changes, and unstable alternate branches during solve.
requirements.acceptance: Branch and mirrored-solution fixtures either retain the intended branch or ask for an explicit alternative selection.
requirements.implementation_note: Wall reversal remapping, closed-loop winding and crossing/overlap checks protect current straight-wall candidate solves; scaled, translated and orthogonal-edit fixtures are added. General branch selection, boundary identity and curve topology remain incomplete.

requirements.requirement: Failed geometric edits preserve the previous valid document state and produce a reversible error result.
requirements.acceptance: Injected solver failures and impossible dimensions leave geometry, calculations, history, and saved revision unchanged.
requirements.implementation_note: Persisted validation and source-bound preview/Apply reject invalid, stale, foreign and modified candidates without partial mutation. Modal commands also reject context changes during prompts. Broader geometry and recovery qualification remain open.

requirements.requirement: Model levels and floor-to-floor relationships through an explicit vertical dependency graph.
requirements.acceptance: Changing a level elevation previews and applies expected dependent changes across plans, sections, and 3D without cycles.
requirements.implementation_note: A validated vertical level graph with connected, frozen, and disconnected floor-to-floor links now has strict version-1 JSON decoding, Document admission through the vertical_levels entity, explicit validated floor bindings, and a Windows Levels editor for revision-checked create/edit/link/freeze/disconnect/assign operations. Newly created walls, slabs, and architectural objects on a bound floor carry an opt-in versioned level placement record; plan, elevation, section, and native 3D projections resolve it from the same snapshot without mutating source coordinates. Site/terrain tools and full cross-view production qualification remain open.

requirements.requirement: Provide a modern Draw First workflow with the documented Apex behavior and equivalent efficient completion path.
requirements.acceptance: A Draw First fixture creates, closes, edits, classifies, calculates, saves, reopens, and prints with expected geometry and command behavior.
requirements.implementation_note: Draw First authoring, atomic commit, dimensions, visibility, undo/redo, and native save/reopen paths are implemented; full Apex-compatible edit/calculate/print fixture remains open.

requirements.requirement: Provide a modern Define First workflow with the documented Apex behavior and equivalent efficient completion path.
requirements.acceptance: A Define First fixture defines an area, enters its geometry, edits it, calculates it, and preserves the expected boundary semantics through save/reopen.
requirements.implementation_note: Define First phase, classification, manual dimensions, closure, and atomic document commit are implemented; integrated edit/calculation/save-reopen acceptance remains open.

requirements.requirement: Build areas from existing geometry and preserve unfinished sketches for later completion.
requirements.acceptance: Existing walls or segments can become a measurement area without duplication, and an unfinished fixture reopens with its edit state intact.
requirements.implementation_note: Unfinished authoring persistence and recovery are implemented and tested. The desktop can now assemble one strict closed room boundary from the connected component of selected analytical walls or from an existing closed boundary, preserving source geometry and issuing one undoable room entity command; branched, open, disconnected, duplicate, and invalid topology fails closed. Broader Apex edit/calculate/output parity remains open.

requirements.requirement: Support keyboard distance-and-direction entry with predictable focus, commit, cancel, and repeat behavior.
requirements.acceptance: Recorded keyboard fixtures create and edit geometry without pointer input and reproduce the documented endpoint and heading results.
requirements.implementation_note: Precision entry forms, retained fields, units, invalid-input rejection, Escape, and Tab focus are implemented; complete keyboard-only creation/edit/repeat fixtures remain open.

requirements.requirement: Accept fractional inches, feet-and-inches, metric units, and unit-aware precision input without lossy intermediate rounding.
requirements.acceptance: Equivalent imperial and metric entries create equivalent analytical geometry and preserve the original entered quantity and unit.
requirements.implementation_note: Partial implementation exists; the complete acceptance statement and production gate remain open.

requirements.requirement: Preserve efficient keyboard semantics and provide an Apex-compatible shortcut preset alongside customizable shortcuts.
requirements.acceptance: Shortcut fixtures pass under the Apex preset, conflicts are reported, and user-customized bindings persist in a workspace.
requirements.implementation_note: Logical Apex operation names, conflict reporting, and deterministic preset bindings are implemented; physical key mapping, customizable workspace persistence, and full keyboard workflow evidence remain open.

requirements.requirement: Support point jumping, automatic closure, and bay-window completion as explicit geometry operations.
requirements.acceptance: Each operation is observable in command history, produces the expected topology, and is undoable.
requirements.implementation_note: Point jumping is dispatched from the desktop without dirtying the project; automatic closure and bay-window completion now publish named identified-boundary commands with exact topology and undo/redo coverage. Physical Apex key mapping, native Apex project fixtures, and production qualification remain open.

requirements.requirement: Expose curved wall and boundary construction through actual curve geometry, including chord, arc length, arc height, and angle definitions.
requirements.acceptance: Curve fixtures calculate correct area and perimeter, retain defining parameters, render smoothly, and remain editable after save/reopen.
requirements.implementation_note: Analytical chord, arc-length, arc-height, and angle construction is implemented with retained receipts and area/perimeter tests. Windows now exposes a bounded curved-wall authoring/editing dialog and API for all three defining measures, stores the original input beside the derived analytical sweep, and validates hosted openings through the wall kernel. Full curved-wall edit/render/save-reopen parity fixtures, joins, and production qualification remain open.

requirements.requirement: Support selection and clipboard operations for geometry, areas, annotations, and architectural objects.
requirements.acceptance: Copy, cut, paste, multi-select, and selection filtering preserve semantic links and produce undoable commands.
requirements.implementation_note: Bounded local JSON clipboard supports copy, paste, cut, and guarded delete for supported geometry graphs; pasted walls carry hosted openings with fresh identities and remapped links, while boundary internals and annotation children are remapped. Multi-select, broader linked-object policies, and production qualification remain open.

requirements.requirement: Support rotation and flipping of supported geometry, areas, references, annotations, and architectural objects with explicit pivot behavior.
requirements.acceptance: Transform fixtures preserve analytical dimensions, typed links, and expected handedness, and can be undone exactly.
requirements.implementation_note: The desktop exposes rotation around a deterministic bounding-box pivot, independent horizontal/vertical reflection, and offsets for identified closed boundaries. Receipt-backed copies and in-place transforms preserve original local construction inputs, topology identities where retained, metadata, and attached dimension placement through atomic commands. The architectural transaction path now applies type-aware transforms to canonical building geometry, dimensions, and local vectors while removing stale generic transform markers. Typed transform history uses format 6 for deterministic reconstruction across save, recovery, and exchange. Broader reference/annotation coverage, linked-relationship propagation, visible architectural binding, and production qualification remain open.

requirements.requirement: Support vertex insertion and cloning for applicable boundaries, walls, and objects without breaking constraints or area topology.
requirements.acceptance: Insertion and clone fixtures preserve valid topology, report any new degrees of freedom, and reopen identically.
requirements.implementation_note: Validated boundary vertex insertion and explicit-ID cloning are implemented; desktop vertex insertion now performs a guarded fresh-ID replacement for identified receipt-free boundaries, migrates typed references, preserves topology and exact undo/redo, and rejects legacy or receipt-bound edits. Wall/object insertion, constraint degrees-of-freedom reporting, broader lifecycle/reopen acceptance, and production qualification remain open.

requirements.requirement: Support reopening, redefining, and deleting areas and supported objects while retaining explicit history and relationships.
requirements.acceptance: Lifecycle fixtures cover reopen, redefine, delete, cancel, and restore with calculations and links matching the committed revision.
requirements.implementation_note: Guarded delete now removes selected walls with owned openings and closed boundaries with dimensions in one undoable command; identified receipt-free boundaries also support same-edge-count redraw redefinition in place with stable reference identities and exact undo/redo. Architectural wall deletion removes only its hosted openings atomically, preserving unrelated objects, and wall duplication creates deterministic fresh opening identities with remapped wall links. Document validation blocks surviving references and annotation children use the typed annotation delete path. Broader reopen/restore fixtures, receipt-bound derivation, object policies, visible architectural binding, and production qualification remain open.

requirements.requirement: Every committed operation, including classification, calibration, and compound edits, supports complete undo and redo.
requirements.acceptance: A mixed command sequence returns byte-equivalent semantic state after undo-all and redo-all, including derived recalculation state.
requirements.implementation_note: Local save/open and deterministic native DXF project mapping are implemented as bounded slices; desktop floor/layer assignment, source-byte retention, additional interchange formats, Apex native compatibility, and the complete fidelity-report acceptance statement remain open.

requirements.requirement: Detect, aggregate, and subtract areas from analytical boundaries with explicit grouping and hole behavior.
requirements.acceptance: Nested, adjacent, overlapping, and disconnected area fixtures produce independently inspectable totals and deductions.
requirements.implementation_note: Analytical calculation, union subtraction, and deterministic endpoint-graph face detection are implemented. The desktop command creates independent room boundaries for all simple bounded faces in one guarded Document transaction; nested-hole semantics, same-floor production fixtures, and complete Apex workflows remain open.

requirements.requirement: Support classifications, base area, factors, net area, and explicit measurement profiles.
requirements.acceptance: Changing classification or factor produces a visible, attributed calculation revision without altering boundary geometry.
requirements.implementation_note: Custom versioned profiles, rational factors and base/net area are implemented; profile inspector and standards fixtures remain open.

requirements.requirement: Report perimeter, living-area totals, building totals, and other required area aggregates with configurable rounding.
requirements.acceptance: Reference fixtures match independently calculated perimeter and totals within the documented tolerance, with rounding shown separately.
requirements.implementation_note: Unrounded aggregation, explicit building/living classifications and display rounding are implemented; production output parity remains open.

requirements.requirement: Make every total inspectable through boundary, deduction, classification, factor, rounding, and provenance details, including documented Auto-Subtract behavior.
requirements.acceptance: The calculation inspector identifies every contributing object and applies the same-type Auto-Subtract rule from the compatibility fixture, with no hidden deduction.
requirements.implementation_note: Deduction contributions, profile provenance, overlap handling, classifications, factors, rounding deltas, and an offline contained-boundary editor are implemented. The editor persists deduction_ids, validates same-floor containment and nested-reference rules, and exposes requested versus marginally applied amounts; documented same-type Auto-Subtract compatibility and production certification remain open.

requirements.requirement: Provide editable text and label libraries with per-instance content, style, placement, and visibility.
requirements.acceptance: Text library fixtures create, edit, filter, hide, and save labels without changing calculation classifications silently.
requirements.implementation_note: Editable label templates, per-instance content/style/placement/visibility, filtering, strict serialization, typed Document admission, save/reopen, and desktop commands for template-backed creation plus text/placement/visibility editing are implemented. The Windows inspector also edits font family, paper text height, stroke/fill colors, bold, and italic flags for labels and symbols through the normal typed history command; output lifecycle and broader style/fill qualification remain open.

requirements.requirement: Provide editable dimensions with placement, visibility, styles, references, and independent output-scale behavior.
requirements.acceptance: Dimension fixtures remain associated with semantic geometry through supported edits, print at the selected output scale, and can be undone.
requirements.implementation_note: Segment-length dimensions have stable references and an inspector for position, paper text height, color, bold/italic, rotation, and visibility. Version 2 presentation survives save/reopen, undo/redo, and boundary transforms. Shared canvas/sheet rendering preserves paper text size across model output scales and fitted previews, with pixel/DPI and rotated-hit tests. Dimension and extension lines, additional dimension kinds, and complete Apex workflow/output qualification remain open.

requirements.requirement: Support editable drawing styles, fills, and visibility controls for areas, objects, and output views.
requirements.acceptance: Style and fill changes affect presentation only, persist across save/reopen, and do not alter analytical geometry.
requirements.implementation_note: Presentation styles, fills, visibility, and target overrides are validated separately from analytical geometry; typed Document persistence, shared vector rendering, undoable child deletion, and annotation inspector visibility/placement edits are integrated, while UI font/color style editing and output-view style integration remain open.

requirements.requirement: Provide an equivalent editable, scalable symbol catalog with more than 200 usable symbols.
requirements.acceptance: The catalog count exceeds 200, each symbol has preview/scale/placement metadata, and representative symbols survive save, print, and export.
requirements.implementation_note: Deterministic catalog generation produces 216 scaled symbol variants with placement metadata and previews; typed Document persistence, shared vector preview rendering, catalog-backed authoring, and inspector placement/visibility edits are integrated, while interactive placement controls, polished assets, and production save/print/export qualification remain open.

requirements.requirement: Import PDF and raster reference images as project assets for tracing and calibrated presentation.
requirements.acceptance: PDF and common raster fixtures import offline with asset identity, page selection, and explicit fidelity/error reporting.
requirements.implementation_note: Reference asset catalog validates PDF/raster signatures, identity, page selection, and immutable source metadata; the desktop imports decodable PNG/JPEG/BMP/TIFF files and a selected PDF page into Document assets, retaining PDF source bytes beside a validated local PNG preview and rendering multiple persisted underlays.

requirements.requirement: Calibrate a reference image against a known measurement and preserve calibration provenance.
requirements.acceptance: A known 100 mm fixture measures within 0.1 mm numerically after calibration, save/reopen, and view transform changes.
requirements.implementation_note: Calibration stores known source distance, unit, scale, and provenance with deterministic validation; the desktop exposes and persists metres-per-source-pixel calibration through the reference inspector and a typed known-distance dialog, and selected PDF previews use the same transform. The Trace selected reference workflow is covered by the desktop smoke path; calibrated production fixtures remain open.

requirements.requirement: Trace over references and support resize, rotate, flip, intensity adjustment, and show/hide controls without changing source assets.
requirements.acceptance: Reference transforms are independently undoable, remain linked to the source asset, and preserve measured geometry.
requirements.implementation_note: Independent resize/rotation/flip/intensity/visibility edits preserve immutable source bytes in the catalog; the desktop inspector applies these transform edits through typed Document undo/redo, and Trace selected reference starts the same receipt-bearing boundary edit lifecycle over any visible underlay.

requirements.requirement: Support multipage projects with subject information, area attributes, page-level presentation, and shared project data.
requirements.acceptance: A multipage fixture preserves subject and area metadata, page order, independent view settings, and linked model references after save/reopen.
requirements.implementation_note: Multipage subject/shared data, areas, stable links, page order, and view semantics are implemented as a standalone contract. The desktop sheet_view_model now supports undoable page add/remove, reference-safe lifecycle validation, selected-page PDF/SVG/print output, and save/reopen through Document. The property entity now projects subject name/address/reference and bounded string attributes through the Project details inspector, and closed boundaries expose bounded area_attributes through the Area attributes inspector; both have undoable save/reopen coverage. The complete multipage acceptance fixture and production qualification remain open.

requirements.requirement: Support local save, import, export, and declared legacy-version exchange workflows with fidelity reports.
requirements.acceptance: Each supported format has a fixture, documented subset, round-trip comparison, and explicit report for data that cannot be preserved.
requirements.implementation_note: Local save/open and deterministic native DXF project mapping are implemented as bounded slices; desktop floor/layer assignment, source-byte retention, additional interchange formats, Apex native compatibility, and the complete fidelity-report acceptance statement remain open.

requirements.requirement: Provide page layouts, print preview, PDF output, and image output with independent output scale.
requirements.acceptance: Layout fixtures preview and export at the selected page size and scale, and output fingerprints identify all influencing inputs.
requirements.implementation_note: Draft PDF, SVG, PNG, and print preview share the validated sheet renderer; PNG uses a deterministic 1600 x 1200 raster target at 144 DPI and writes the same adjacent output fingerprint contract. Physical printer calibration, complete page-layout qualification, Apex output comparison, and the production gate remain open.

requirements.requirement: Provide pan, zoom, grid, independent output scale, and responsive overview navigation without rebuilding the whole interface.
requirements.acceptance: Navigation fixtures retain input responsiveness while derived geometry rendering updates asynchronously and view state persists.
requirements.implementation_note: The desktop shell exposes pan, zoom, grid, and independent output controls; the primary toolbar is a fixed 20 px logical row with 14 px icons and no redundant header band. Interactive plan canvases now render a model-space overview map with viewport framing and click-to-recenter navigation; asynchronous navigation evidence and the complete acceptance statement remain open.

requirements.requirement: Provide visibility filters, overview map, light/dark themes, and saved workspace configurations.
requirements.acceptance: Workspace fixtures save and restore filters, theme, overview, and panel state without changing document geometry.
requirements.implementation_note: Derived floor/layer masks and native presentation/picking filtering pass focused Debug/Release tests. The desktop now applies light, dark, and high-contrast themes and saves/restores bounded local workspace profiles for workspace, units, grid/snap, view, page size, visibility filters, overview-map visibility, and workspace/architectural panel proportions; asynchronous navigation and complete acceptance remain open.

requirements.requirement: Provide a searchable command palette, customizable quick-access commands, shortcut editing, and view tabs.
requirements.acceptance: Every exposed command is searchable, can be bound where supported, reports conflicts, and remains available from keyboard and pointer paths.
requirements.implementation_note: The desktop exposes a searchable command palette, a compact Quick access menu, and a locally persisted checklist editor for supported commands. Invalid settings fail closed to bounded defaults; full command coverage, physical shortcut verification, and production acceptance remain open.

requirements.requirement: Support mouse, keyboard, active pen, and touch input for precision drawing and editing.
requirements.acceptance: Recorded mouse/keyboard, real pen, and real touch fixtures complete core draw/edit operations with correct focus, pressure-independent geometry, and undo.
requirements.implementation_note: Straight and curved wall geometry share semantic wall identity, thickness, openings, transforms, projection, schedules, and output; Windows now exposes explicit curved-wall authoring. Composite joins, material/quantity certification, and complete production acceptance remain open.

requirements.requirement: Support DISTO measurement input through an adapter that targets an explicitly selected field and retains units and provenance.
requirements.acceptance: At least one selected DISTO model/transport fixture records a reading in the intended field without silently overwriting another measurement.
requirements.blocker: Exact DISTO model, firmware, transport, and available test hardware must be identified and exercised.
requirements.implementation_note: Offline DISTO reading/assignment and provenance contracts are implemented; exact model/firmware/transport, device adapter, and hardware fixture evidence remain required.

requirements.requirement: Provide survey and metes-and-bounds workflows with traverse geometry, acreage calculation, closure diagnostics, and output.
requirements.acceptance: Survey fixtures import or enter bearings/distances, report closure and acreage, preserve traverse provenance, and export the declared result.
requirements.implementation_note: Survey traverse legs, closure diagnostics, simple-polygon area, acreage, and provenance are implemented. The desktop supports decimal and degrees:minutes:seconds entry, calculation, report export/reopen with recomputation, and insertion of closed traverses as undoable project boundaries retaining original source metadata. Desktop tests cover stale-context rejection, save/reopen, history, and shared SVG output. Updating existing traverses from calls, Apex survey exchange, legal-survey behavior, and production fixtures remain open.

requirements.requirement: Provide the Pro georeferencing workflow with explicit coordinate reference, control points, residuals, and offline resources.
requirements.acceptance: A georeferencing fixture records control points and residuals, applies the selected transform, and reopens without a network request.
requirements.implementation_note: Explicit projected-metre CRS, affine transform, control-point residuals, and offline resource declarations are validated. Version-1 JSON is strict and derived residuals are recomputed; a typed georeferencing Document entity survives save/reopen. The Windows editor supports persisted CRS/transform/control-point/resource entry, residual and sample-transform feedback, and normal Document history with desktop smoke coverage. The runtime verifies contained resources and hashes, binds the local proj.db, disables networking, validates both CRS declarations, and exercises an identity operation. Apex module behavior, transform comparison, and production fixtures remain open.

requirements.requirement: Provide appraisal-software integrations through isolated, versioned adapters with explicit field mapping and failure behavior.
requirements.acceptance: Each supported appraisal application/version has an exchange fixture, field mapping, round-trip or one-way fidelity report, and offline failure test.
requirements.blocker: Actual target appraisal applications, versions, exchange formats, and available caller interfaces are not yet identified.
requirements.implementation_note: Versioned appraisal field-mapping descriptors and deterministic one-way payload contracts are implemented; target applications, adapters, and exchange fixtures remain to be discovered and exercised.

requirements.requirement: Document and implement caller protocols for external integrations without coupling them to the drawing engine.
requirements.acceptance: Each caller protocol has a versioned adapter contract, capability negotiation, timeout/error semantics, and a recorded compatibility fixture.
requirements.blocker: Caller protocols and exact external integration contracts require discovery from representative applications and observed exchanges.
requirements.implementation_note: Caller identity/version/mapping compatibility and failure semantics are declared; real caller protocols, capability negotiation, timeout enforcement, isolation, and compatibility fixtures remain open.

requirements.requirement: Import and preserve supported native Apex v5 projects with geometry, curves, classifications, dimensions, labels, symbols, imagery, and metadata where representable.
requirements.acceptance: Representative Apex v5 fixtures open with a field-by-field fidelity report and round-trip or preservation result for every supported data class.
requirements.blocker: Representative native Apex v5 files and format evidence are required; PDF tracing cannot satisfy this row.
requirements.implementation_note: Evidence schema and hash comparison tooling are implemented; native Apex v5 fixtures, parser/import/export behavior, and independent fidelity certification remain open.

requirements.requirement: Import, edit, and preserve supported native Apex v7 projects with geometry, curves, classifications, dimensions, labels, symbols, imagery, and metadata where representable.
requirements.acceptance: Representative Apex v7 fixtures open, edit, save, and export with a field-by-field fidelity report and no silent loss of required content.
requirements.blocker: Representative native Apex v7 files and format evidence are required; PDF tracing cannot satisfy this row.
requirements.implementation_note: Evidence schema and hash comparison tooling are implemented; native Apex v7 fixtures, parser/import/export behavior, and independent fidelity certification remain open.

requirements.requirement: Export declared legacy Apex-compatible versions with explicit subset, loss, and round-trip behavior.
requirements.acceptance: Each declared legacy export has a real consumer fixture, output comparison, and visible report for unsupported or transformed content.
requirements.blocker: Target legacy versions and consumer fixtures are not yet available.
requirements.implementation_note: Legacy target evidence and output comparison schema are implemented; declared legacy versions, real consumers, and compatibility export behavior remain open.

requirements.requirement: Audit Apex Standard, Pro, and enabled modules rather than infer feature scope from purchase price or public documentation alone.
requirements.acceptance: The ledger records the installed edition/module inventory, observed behavior, settings, version, and fixture for every required capability.
requirements.blocker: Installed Apex editions, enabled modules, settings, and version information must be collected.
requirements.implementation_note: Standard/Pro/module inventory is required and validated by the evidence manifest; installed edition/module observations and independent audit evidence remain open.

requirements.requirement: Compare representative Apex projects and expected outputs across geometry, curves, classifications, dimensions, labels, symbols, imagery, metadata, calculations, and print/export.
requirements.acceptance: A compatibility report compares paired source/replacement projects and outputs, identifies any loss, and leaves no required mismatch unclassified.
requirements.blocker: Representative projects, source outputs, and acceptance expectations are not yet available.
requirements.implementation_note: Paired project/output hashes and per-field observations are represented by the evidence manifest; representative projects, outputs, and independent comparison remain open.

requirements.requirement: Author straight, curved, sloped, and composite walls with joins, thickness, materials, and stable semantic identity.
requirements.acceptance: Wall fixtures create and edit each type in plan, elevation, section, and 3D while preserving joins, quantities, and links.
requirements.implementation_note: Partial implementation exists; the complete acceptance statement and production gate remain open.

requirements.requirement: Author hosted doors, windows, and openings with type/instance properties and wall relationships.
requirements.acceptance: Opening fixtures host, move, resize, replace, schedule, and export without losing wall geometry or handedness data.
requirements.implementation_note: Hosted door/window cuts now use a single dimension editor with live unrolled elevation preview, complete host-opening semantic validation, revision/context fencing, and one-command undo/redo. Optional versioned handing and swing now drive creation, inspector edits, analytic plan leaf/arc geometry, and schedule cells, with save/reopen and geometry tests. The current 3D solid remains a cut in the host; type-driven assemblies, frame/leaf/glazing geometry, and complete export acceptance remain open.

requirements.requirement: Author floors, ceilings, foundations, and their materials, levels, boundaries, and quantities.
requirements.acceptance: Floor-system fixtures appear correctly in plans, sections, elevations, and 3D and contribute the declared schedule quantities.
requirements.implementation_note: Partial implementation exists; the complete acceptance statement and production gate remain open.

requirements.requirement: Author beams and columns suitable for residential and light-commercial building documentation.
requirements.acceptance: Beam and column fixtures support creation, placement, property editing, section display, schedules, and save/reopen.
requirements.implementation_note: Rectangular/circular columns and arbitrary-axis beams have semantic solids, parameter editors, and exact top-down plan projections. Section display, schedules and production acceptance remain open.

requirements.requirement: Author flat, shed, gable, and hip roof forms with slopes, joins, openings where supported, and materials.
requirements.acceptance: Roof fixtures produce correct plan, elevation, section, and editable 3D representations and retain defining parameters.
requirements.implementation_note: Sloped panels (including zero-rise flat roofs), gable roofs, and equal-pitch rectangular hip roofs have semantic solids, parameter editors, plan projections, and contextual inspector dimensions with derived pitch preview. Hip roofs include the square pyramidal case, exact persistence and native 3D rendering, with analytic plan/elevation/section bounds tests. Rectangular vertical through-openings are supported on panel, gable and hip forms with versioned persistence, overlap/clearance validation, undo/redo and native 3D rendering. Roof joins, materials and coordinated production qualification remain open.

requirements.requirement: Author stairs, landings, and railings with level connections and editable dimensions.
requirements.acceptance: Stair fixtures validate supported dimensions, display in all required views, and save/reopen with connected levels intact.
requirements.implementation_note: Straight stair flights with optional landings and straight railings with validated top rails and endpoint/interior posts have semantic solids, parameter editors, transforms, exact top-down projections, native 3D rendering, and save/reopen coverage. Curved or baluster profiles, stair hosting, level connections and coordinated production acceptance remain open.

requirements.requirement: Provide levels, reference grids, floor-to-floor alignment, and basic site/terrain tools.
requirements.acceptance: Level, grid, and site fixtures coordinate plans, sections, elevations, and 3D without ambiguous vertical references.
requirements.implementation_note: Vertical level and floor-to-floor relationship semantics are implemented as a standalone graph. Floors can bind to a validated graph entity and level through revisioned desktop controls with save/reopen coverage. Reference grids now have strict version-1 persistence, a revision-checked Windows editor, deterministic rotated line generation, shared measurement/architectural canvas rendering, and axis labels in screen and fit-to-content output. Newly created walls, slabs, and architectural objects on a bound floor resolve through an opt-in level placement record across plan, elevation, section, and native 3D without mutating source coordinates. A bounded version-1 terrain_surface TIN now validates stable points, triangle topology, contours, deduplicated plan edges, native OCCT faces, and selected-boundary authoring across plan/elevation/section/3D. Full site coordination, georeferencing, survey-device exchange, Apex terrain compatibility, coordinated view propagation, and production qualification remain open.

requirements.requirement: Provide reusable assemblies with separate type and instance properties, materials, and quantity behavior.
requirements.acceptance: Changing a type updates its instances according to explicit rules while instance overrides remain visible and undoable.
requirements.implementation_note: Reusable assembly types, instance overrides, materials, quantities, immutable snapshots, and update previews are implemented. The Windows Assembly catalog now creates and persists typed type/instance records, supports rename/add/remove through Document history, edits local materials plus typed property/material-slot/quantity declarations and per-instance overrides, and blocks dangling type deletion. Geometric placement, quantity/schedule integration, nested assemblies, and production qualification remain open.

requirements.requirement: Model rooms and architectural boundaries separately from appraisal measurement boundaries, with explicit relationships where desired.
requirements.acceptance: A room can relate to, follow, or remain independent from a measurement boundary without silently conflating classifications or geometry.
requirements.implementation_note: Room, appraisal-boundary, and architectural-wall references have separate kinds with independent/follows/derived-from relations and graph validation. A typed room_relationships Document entity and Windows editor now persist and validate declarations through undoable history; selected closed geometry can be copied into a distinct named room_boundary entity; a detached proposal engine validates rigid target-first propagation and multi-driver agreement without mutation; a revision-bound Document adapter commits identified and receipt-backed boundary changes atomically with dependent dimensions and digest/stale checks; the Windows editor provides a visible canvas preview and confirmation step. Controlled retargeting and production evidence remain open.

requirements.requirement: Support existing, demolished, and proposed phases across the model, views, calculations, schedules, and sheets.
requirements.acceptance: Phase fixtures show the selected state consistently in every required view and can be changed through undoable commands.
requirements.implementation_note: Immutable existing/demolished/proposed phase state and validation are implemented. Canvas visibility and the revision-bound schedule projection now honor the active phase on canonical source entities, including derived material rows; calculation-inspector, sheet, and broader persistence qualification remain open.

requirements.requirement: Support mutually exclusive remodeling alternatives over a shared existing model with clear comparison state.
requirements.acceptance: Alternative fixtures switch, compare, save, and print without contaminating one another or changing the shared existing state.
requirements.implementation_note: Mutually exclusive remodeling alternatives over a shared baseline and deterministic comparison state are implemented; coordinated model/views, save/print, and undo integration remain open.

requirements.requirement: Provide editable 3D authoring over the same semantic objects used by measurement and 2D documentation.
requirements.acceptance: A 3D edit changes the shared object and is visible in linked plan/elevation/section views, schedules, calculations, and save/reopen.
requirements.implementation_note: Native solids, selection, linked inspector edits and navigation are implemented; full 3D authoring/gizmos and remaining object types remain open.

requirements.requirement: Provide coordinated plans, elevations, and sections that edit and display the same building objects.
requirements.acceptance: A representative wall/opening/roof edit in any view updates the other views and retains stable references.
requirements.implementation_note: Immutable coordinated plan/elevation/section view references and frame validation persist through a typed Document entity, and new projects seed all three persisted frames. Supported semantic building objects now have analytical hidden-line plan/elevation and true solid-plane section projection tests. The Architectural selector consumes persisted frames when present, view presentation settings are editable through typed history, and the renderer applies conservative BRep-bounds far-depth culling with cache invalidation when frame limits change. Exact clipping, shared object editing, renderer synchronization, and sheet layout remain open.

requirements.requirement: Sections support cut depth, line treatment, material hatching, annotations, and detail overlays.
requirements.acceptance: Section fixtures render and print the selected cut and presentation settings and preserve them in the project.
requirements.implementation_note: Section presentation settings are validated and persist through the typed Document entity; analytical solid-plane section edges and persisted section cut-depth consumption are implemented for supported objects, and the desktop view settings command edits cut/far depth, line widths, hatching and detail through Document history. A conservative object-level BRep-bounds far-depth filter now culls solids wholly beyond the selected limit while retaining objects that cross it for a future exact clipping pass. Line/hatch/annotation overlays and print fixtures remain open.

requirements.requirement: Provide door/window, room, and material schedules with the required marks, properties, dimensions, counts, areas, deductions, and net quantities.
requirements.acceptance: Schedules generated from a representative project match the semantic model and update after accepted object edits.
requirements.implementation_note: Standalone typed records and a revision-bound Document-derived adapter now generate door/window, room, and material rows with stable marks, source-backed calculated cells and explicit diagnostics. Active organization/design-phase masks filter source entities before projection, preserving derived material rows and suppressing hidden-source diagnostics. Architectural projections append deterministic read-only material-summary rows grouped by catalog/material identity or normalized explicit name, with aggregate counts, complete net-volume totals when every source is valid, and all contributing provenance. Schedule persistence and complete sheet/output integration remain open.

requirements.requirement: Editable schedule cells issue normal document commands; calculated cells are read-only and expose their source.
requirements.acceptance: Editing a permitted cell creates history and updates the model; editing a calculated cell is prevented with a source explanation.
requirements.implementation_note: Deterministic edit descriptions and fail-closed calculated-cell source references are implemented; accepted source-cell edits now dispatch through revision-checked Document commands/history and the desktop dialog exposes the edit action. Complete production schedule/output coverage remains open.

requirements.requirement: Provide coordinated sheets with title blocks, revisions, callouts, schedules, and independently scaled viewports.
requirements.acceptance: Sheet fixtures preserve viewport scale, linked annotations, schedules, title-block data, and revision information through print/export.
requirements.implementation_note: Coordinated sheets with title blocks, revisions, callouts, schedule references, page sizes, and independent viewport scales are implemented as immutable semantic records and persist through the typed Document entity. New desktop projects seed validated plan/elevation/section views and a default sheet containing one viewport for each view; draft PDF/SVG/print consume persisted page, viewport, title-block, scale, schedule placement, and view-specific derived geometry data even when another workspace is active, while sheet number/title-block, viewport bounds/scale, and schedule placement bounds edits commit through Document history. Printer receipts and production output qualification remain open.

requirements.requirement: Every supported architectural object supports creation, selection, property editing, appropriate transforms, duplication, deletion, undo/redo, and save/reopen.
requirements.acceptance: Object-family fixtures execute the complete lifecycle and compare semantic, geometric, view, schedule, and persistence state.
requirements.implementation_note: Architectural create/select/property-edit/transform/duplicate/delete intents are translated into one revision-fenced atomic Document command with preview, undo, and save/reopen coverage. Recognized building entities receive type-aware canonical transforms, and wall duplication/deletion carries or removes hosted openings with deterministic remapping. The Windows editor exposes scale, rotation, XYZ translation, clone, and preview controls for recognized building objects. Complete type schemas, cross-view relationship propagation, and user-observed output remain open.

requirements.requirement: Plans, elevations, sections, 3D, calculations, schedules, and sheets use explicit stable references to the same semantic objects.
requirements.acceptance: Deleting or changing a referenced feature produces a visible issue or controlled update rather than silently retargeting an annotation or schedule row.
requirements.implementation_note: Typed stable references and cycle/ambiguity validation are present, and the Windows editor now exposes live relationship declarations through typed Document history; cross-view semantic object persistence and controlled retargeting remain open.

requirements.requirement: Support complete residential and light-commercial remodel documentation from existing conditions through alternatives and coordinated output.
requirements.acceptance: End-to-end residential and light-commercial remodel fixtures produce editable model, comparison views, schedules, and sheets from one project.
requirements.implementation_note: Coordinated plan/elevation/section/3D/schedule output requirements are scoped to model and sheet revisions; actual projection/render/layout/export and end-to-end residential/light-commercial deliverables remain open.

requirements.requirement: Use a canvas-centered workspace with compact tool rail, expandable navigator, contextual inspector, and cursor-adjacent measurement panel.
requirements.acceptance: Representative workflows expose relevant controls in context, keep the canvas dominant, and preserve panel layout in saved workspaces.
requirements.implementation_note: The canvas-centered shell, compact tool rail, navigator, and contextual inspector are exercised by the desktop smoke workflow; the fixed toolbar keeps the canvas close to the window edge. Precision drawing now exposes a compact transient cursor readout for effective coordinates and anchored delta length/angle, excluded from fitted/exported scenes. Physical-input, DPI, and the complete acceptance statement remain open.

requirements.requirement: Selecting a wall, area, reference, or architectural object exposes its relevant dimensions, relationships, styling, calibration, classifications, or calculations without unrelated modal dialogs.
requirements.acceptance: Selection fixtures show contextual properties and commit edits through normal commands with clear validation errors.
requirements.implementation_note: Partial implementation exists; the complete acceptance statement and production gate remain open.

requirements.requirement: Provide split plan/3D views, view tabs, saved workspaces, light/dark themes, and a high-contrast field mode.
requirements.acceptance: Workspace and theme fixtures restore view arrangement and remain usable at supported DPI scales without changing document data.
requirements.implementation_note: Plan/3D split and view tabs are implemented; local saved workspace profiles now restore workspace, theme, units, grid/snap, view, page size, and visibility filters. Complete field-mode and layout acceptance remain open.

requirements.requirement: Support keyboard navigation, predictable focus, accessible properties and commands, high contrast, and layouts from 1366x768 through 4K at 100%, 150%, and 200% scaling.
requirements.acceptance: Accessibility and DPI fixtures complete core workflows without clipped controls, lost focus, inaccessible properties, or unreadable contrast.
requirements.implementation_note: Keyboard/focus/properties/high-contrast themes and DPI layouts are declared by a strict profile and qualification manifest; physical keyboard, assistive-technology, visual, and clean-layout evidence remain open.

requirements.requirement: Provide pen/touch-specific controls and an on-screen measurement keypad while preserving keyboard precision paths.
requirements.acceptance: Real pen/touch fixtures enter and commit measurements through the keypad, preserve units/provenance, and remain undoable.
requirements.implementation_note: Pen/touch controls and an on-screen keypad are declared by the interaction profile and qualification manifest; physical pen/touch runs, device drivers, and end-to-end keypad command integration remain open.

requirements.requirement: Provide optional offline suggested tracing from plans or reference images.
requirements.acceptance: A local model or deterministic assistant suggests trace geometry on a fixture without network access and labels every suggestion unverified.
requirements.implementation_note: Offline tracing now has a deterministic local raster engine, source bounds, explicit calibration and identified-boundary desktop dispatch; arbitrary-plan accuracy and production qualification remain open.

requirements.requirement: Provide optional offline dimension extraction from supported plans and references.
requirements.acceptance: Extracted dimensions are visibly provisional, include source location/confidence, and require acceptance before becoming document commands.
requirements.implementation_note: Offline explicit-unit extraction now retains source text/offset/confidence and can atomically upgrade a legacy target boundary and create a typed dimension; plan-accuracy and production qualification remain open.

requirements.requirement: Provide optional assisted label placement and natural-language commands through the same command and permission model as manual edits.
requirements.acceptance: Suggestions preview as normal typed commands, identify affected entities, require acceptance, and are fully undoable.
requirements.implementation_note: Offline label placement and bounded natural-language commands now produce typed proposals and dispatch through annotation/boundary/workspace command paths; broader language coverage and production qualification remain open.

requirements.requirement: Assistance never silently invents measurements, changes classifications, or modifies accepted geometry; disabling it does not affect deterministic workflows.
requirements.acceptance: Assistance-off and malformed-suggestion tests complete draw/edit/calculate/save/print/export, and unaccepted suggestions leave no semantic changes.
requirements.implementation_note: The deterministic engine and desktop workflow tests prove disabled/unaccepted safety, normal undo/history and fail-closed malformed inputs; full draw/edit/calculate/save/print/export qualification remains open.

requirements.requirement: Distributed assistance assets and processing libraries have offline resource paths, provenance, and license records.
requirements.acceptance: The offline package contains or explicitly omits optional assets, reports missing local resources, and passes the same source/license audit as core dependencies.
requirements.implementation_note: The deterministic engine declares portable resource paths and private-source provenance, and its fixture is allowlisted; package hash/license audit and clean-machine qualification remain open.

requirements.requirement: Provide local autosave, recoverable history, and crash/power-loss recovery with explicit edited, autosaved, and saved states.
requirements.acceptance: Crash and power-interruption fixtures recover the last valid revision, identify the session and checksum, and never silently overwrite the saved source.
requirements.implementation_note: Owner-thread scheduling, queued immutable captures, guarded recovery archives, timed coverage for recovered, legacy, and untitled projects, read-only recovery-candidate discovery, startup selection of unsaved unbound copies, a native Recover action, and ownership-verified Save As cleanup/rebasing are implemented; crash/power interruption fixtures, broader restart qualification, and final restore certification remain open.

requirements.requirement: Provide named revisions and comparison views for semantic, geometric, calculation, and presentation changes.
requirements.acceptance: Two named revisions can be compared and restored without losing later work or changing the original revision.
requirements.implementation_note: The Document NameRevision command is now surfaced in a local desktop editor with ordered listing, read-only entity/asset comparison, and guarded restore-as-new-project copies that preserve the open document. Geometric/calculation/presentation diff detail and production fixtures remain open.

requirements.requirement: Provide portable project packages and reusable templates containing required assets, profiles, and documentation references.
requirements.acceptance: A package copied to another offline Windows machine opens with all required assets and produces the same calculated and output fingerprints.
requirements.implementation_note: Portable staging validates explicit inventories and emits relative-path integrity manifests; project-package assembly, asset closure, templates, and cross-machine offline fingerprint acceptance remain open.

requirements.requirement: Detect external changes and enforce exclusive editing ownership, with read-only or independent-copy behavior for a second opening.
requirements.acceptance: Concurrent-open and external-change fixtures prevent silent overwrite and make the selected read-only/copy path explicit.
requirements.implementation_note: Partial implementation exists; the complete acceptance statement and production gate remain open.

requirements.requirement: Failure-injection tests cover transaction, serialization, flush, replacement, recovery, migration, disk exhaustion, file locks, damaged assets, stale recovery, and newer schemas.
requirements.acceptance: Each injected failure has an expected recoverable result, evidence log, and no corrupted authoritative project is presented as valid.
requirements.implementation_note: Partial implementation exists; the complete acceptance statement and production gate remain open.

requirements.requirement: Support the declared IFC4 ADD2 TC1 Reference View 1.2 interchange target with editable reconstruction where reliable and identifiable reference preservation otherwise.
requirements.acceptance: Representative IFC fixtures export/import with a fidelity report for geometry, types, properties, materials, relationships, and unreconstructed content.
requirements.implementation_note: A bounded IFC4 STEP project mapper now exports linear boundaries, wall axes, slab footprints and optional swept solids, and imports reliable product geometry with identifiable source metadata. Worker isolation, Reference View conformance, full types/properties/materials/relationships, desktop source retention, and representative cross-application fixtures remain open.

requirements.requirement: Support a declared DXF R2013 subset covering lines, arcs, polylines, text, dimensions, hatches, and blocks.
requirements.acceptance: Subset fixtures round-trip supported entities and report unsupported entities without blocking native project use.
requirements.implementation_note: A bounded in-memory ASCII DXF R2013 codec now round-trips LINE, ARC, LWPOLYLINE (including bulges), plain TEXT, linear DIMENSION records, one-loop solid polygon HATCH records, BLOCK definitions, and INSERT references with deterministic serialization, hard limits, and explicit unsupported-feature diagnostics. A separate native project-mapping layer now translates immutable snapshots to that drawing model and reconstructs bounded geometry into editable boundary candidates plus typed annotation state, with explicit source-retention diagnostics. It does not claim nested blocks, patterned or multi-loop hatches, native Apex compatibility, active floor/layer assignment, original-source asset retention, worker isolation, or external CAD fidelity; those fixtures and integrations remain open.

requirements.requirement: Treat PDF and raster underlays as calibrated reference assets, and distinguish editable extraction from simple tracing or image display.
requirements.acceptance: Import reports whether content is editable, traceable, or image-only and preserves calibration and source provenance.
requirements.implementation_note: Reference assets carry explicit fidelity mode, source identity, page selection, calibration, and transforms; selected PDF pages and multiple project-level underlays persist through the desktop Document path, while editable PDF extraction remains open.

requirements.requirement: Preview, PDF, SVG, and printing consume one vector scene; raster imagery and shaded 3D are explicitly identified raster content.
requirements.acceptance: Paired output fixtures compare scene geometry, scale, text, dimensions, and raster placement across preview and exported/printed results.
requirements.implementation_note: Preview, draft PDF, draft SVG, and print use one shared canvas geometry renderer; draft exports now render persisted sheet bounds, independent viewport scales, title-block data, and revision-bound schedule placements with a visible draft stamp. PDF, SVG, and native 3D image exports emit adjacent fingerprint manifests; currentness blocking, printer receipts, and authoritative output fixtures remain open.

requirements.requirement: Support Letter, Legal, Tabloid, A4, A3, and architectural sheet sizes with independent scale and printer calibration verification.
requirements.acceptance: Each sheet fixture reports numeric page dimensions and a physical/driver scaling check separately from PDF geometry.
requirements.implementation_note: Letter, Legal, Tabloid, A4, A3, and architectural page sizes plus independent viewport scales are validated; the desktop selector applies the five named sizes to draft PDF/print, the persisted sheet renderer maps viewport bounds/scales to paper coordinates, and viewport bounds/scale edits use typed Document history. Print preview records driver page/DPI evidence; physical printer calibration and output evidence remain open.

requirements.requirement: Block authoritative output or clearly mark drafts when calculations, required references, assets, or fingerprints are stale or incomplete.
requirements.acceptance: Stale-calculation, missing-asset, broken-link, and incomplete-drawing fixtures cannot silently produce an authoritative file.
requirements.implementation_note: Draft output stamping covers PDF, SVG, print, and native 3D images; native image export stages a visible draft/filter footer before atomic destination replacement and fails on read/stamp/write errors while retaining the fingerprint sidecar. Invalid-geometry blocking, fingerprint mismatch checks, and revision-bound persisted schedule placement rendering are implemented; integrated stale calculations/assets/reference fixtures and visible authority wiring remain open.

requirements.requirement: Run untrusted import workers in Windows AppContainer without network capabilities, with Job Object limits, brokered inputs, controlled temporary storage, and fixed search paths.
requirements.acceptance: A worker security fixture verifies token/container policy, network denial, resource limits, path restrictions, and controlled parent termination.
requirements.implementation_note: Fail-closed worker policy and attestation/resource/path checks are implemented. The Windows broker now provisions an AppContainer profile, ACL-protected job directory, explicit handle list, controlled environment, suspended launch, Job Object limits, and post-launch token/network attestation; live clean-machine evidence remains required, and the runtime fixture skips when its host process is already inside a parent Job Object.

requirements.requirement: Contain malformed imports, path traversal, decompression bombs, DLL/module planting, child-process escape, timeouts, and worker crashes.
requirements.acceptance: Adversarial fixtures terminate or reject safely, leave the core project usable, and produce actionable local diagnostics without network access.
requirements.implementation_note: Malformed input, traversal, expansion, timeout, child-process, crash, and module-path rejection decisions are covered by policy tests. The native broker rejects unsafe roots and limits output, terminates the whole Job Object on watchdog or output failure, and never returns partial output; adversarial clean-machine OS fixtures and project-survival evidence remain open.

requirements.requirement: Disable PROJ networking and custom network callbacks; missing coordinate resources produce a local diagnostic instead of an attempted download.
requirements.acceptance: Network-denied georeferencing fixtures either use bundled resources or fail locally with no network request.
requirements.implementation_note: Policy requires offline PROJ resource declarations and reports missing resources locally. The native worker environment sets PROJ_NETWORK=OFF and omits network capabilities; the Windows georeferencing runtime additionally disables the PROJ context, binds a contained local database, and fails on missing or mismatched resources. Externally monitored network-denied worker evidence remains open.

requirements.requirement: Target 95th-percentile navigation frame time at or below 16.7 ms on agreed reference hardware for representative workloads.
requirements.acceptance: Recorded 50,000-entity, 10,000-object/one-million-triangle, and 20-sheet/250 MB workloads meet the measured target or produce an explicit unresolved gate failure.
requirements.implementation_note: Deterministic p95 navigation reporting and threshold checks are implemented; representative workloads, reference hardware runs, and final performance evidence remain open.

requirements.requirement: Target input feedback at or below 50 ms and ordinary edits at or below 250 ms, with expensive regeneration in cancellable background work.
